sentences.en: Other important cities, with their populations, were Selma (8713), Anniston (9695), Huntsville (8068), Bessemer (6358), Tuscaloosa (5094), Talladega (5056), Eufaula (4532) and Tuskegee (2170).

sentences.en: Cooking schools and night schools are carried on by the institute in the town of Tuskegee.

sentences.en: Tuskegee is chiefly known for its educational institutions - the Tuskegee Normal and Industrial Institute and the Alabama Conference Female College (Methodist Episcopal Church, South; opened 1856).
sentences.vi: Tuskegee chủ yếu được biết đến với các cơ sở giáo dục của nó - Viện Công nghiệp và Bình thường Tuskegee và Trường Cao đẳng Nữ thuộc Hội nghị Alabama (Nhà thờ Methodist Episcopal, mở cửa năm 1856).
Tuskegee đã được định cư vào khoảng năm 1800.

sentences.en: But others at the Tuskegee meeting cautioned against dismissing too casually possible genetic differences in health outcomes among racial and ethnic groups.

sentences.en: Lee Archer is one of the famous Tuskegee Airmen.

sentences.en: The Tuskegee Airmen were the first black fighter pilots who fought during World War Two in the United States Army Air Corps.
